features.name: AQI
features.reason: Composite index computed from several pollutants with the max sub-index; shown to disagree with PM2.5 (PM2.5 ~10 => AQI up to 161). Redundant and non-monotonic as a PM2.5 feature.

features.name: road_density / primary_road_km
features.reason: Time-invariant. Cannot change the 3-24h forecast for a single point because the station location never changes. Only useful for spatial generalisation (LUR / multi-station), not for time-series forecasting.

features.name: construction_sites / fuel_stations
features.reason: Same as road density: static, low time variance, no per-hour signal.

features.name: fire_hotspot_count / fire_frp
features.reason: Full 2022-2026 history downloaded with a MAP_KEY: 66,208 detections covering 1692/1692 days. Correlates r=+0.47 with PM2.5 (3-day window, 100 km) and r=+0.33 after removing month effects, but adds no MAE gain to the 3h model because PM10 already carries the dust signal.

features.name: traffic_flow (volume / congestion)
features.reason: No public free API for historical hourly traffic in Hanoi. Google Distance Matrix has no history; here/tomtom require a commercial licence. Proxy features (hour, dow, holiday, road_density) are already in the model.

features.name: ENSO / ONI
features.reason: Correlation with monthly PM2.5 r=-0.09 (p=0.50). Also monthly resolution, unusable for 3-24h horizon.

features.name: PM10_PM25_ratio
features.reason: Ranked 2nd by importance in ablation, no new data needed.

features.name: Pressure_lag1 / Pressure_anom_24
features.reason: Inversion proxy; pressure autocorrelation makes these informative.

features.name: wd_sin / wd_cos / wind_calm / wind_roll6
features.reason: Fixes the circular-variable problem of raw bearings and encodes dispersion conditions (calm wind 38.7 vs windy 29.3 ug/m3).

features.name: hours_since_rain
features.reason: Washout decays over hours; raw precipitation misses the decay.
